expected.title: Flour for the bakery
expected.pitch: My loft is near empty and the mill's cart will not come till dawn. Bring me a sack of flour from the Kipdorp mill's sack store at the foot of the wall, to my door. Keep it dry.

expected.title: Flour for the bakery
expected.pitch: My loft is near empty and the mill's cart will not come till dawn. Take the miller's barrow and bring three sacks of flour from the Kipdorp mill's sack store at the foot of the wall, to my door. Keep it dry.

expected.title: Grain up from the dock

expected.title: An hour at the mill
